study.question: Should auxiliary tasks consume and optimize a common positional history route, or should positional routing remain owned by individual tasks? The observed limitation is that the successful event-position route has never had its task sharing and loss ownership separated.
study.hypothesis: Observed: g3-r0014-position_collapsed click AUC0.66550816 versus marginal_collapsed0.66380238 (+0.00170578); resolved position0.66550223 versus resolved marginal0.66377444. Feedback identity in this added route has little observed click effect, while position helps history1-16,17-64,>64 by about0.00136,0.00205,0.00179. This is one-seed controlled support for event-position association, not repeated support. Earlier primary-owned selector0.65760862 exceeded joint0.65546078; private auxiliary embeddings later restored auxiliary quality (r0005 cart/fav/buy AUC0.84849/0.86590/0.86867 versus r0003 detached shared tables0.67982/0.72358/0.66262). Auxiliary gate donors r0012_aux_live0.66304711 failed to beat self_live0.66334880. These trajectories motivate, but do not prove, the hypothesis that the new positional geometry can be consumed by all tasks while its optimization should remain click-owned: broad category/brand24h labels may favor positional weights that conflict with impression click ranking. Different pathways, ancestors and capacities preclude treating these historical outcomes as matched evidence for this new mechanism. The current raw receipts are successful executions; negative comparative findings are not runtime failures. No personal memory is supplied and agent-memory searches returned no matches.

nearest_work.difference: Read primary archived text lines236-300: target-conditioned local activation and unnormalized pooling are inherited. The new intervention concerns ownership of an existing four-kernel positional correction across four tasks; it does not invent attention or position weighting, nor exactly reproduce DIN.

Read pinned implementation lines123-172 and204-313: feedback-mask-specific sequence hubs, shared/task hubs, aggregation and gated broadcast. Here share only an existing scalar input-only position correction, isolate forward sharing from backward ownership, and retain incumbent DIN-style pooling. No hub/token architecture is reproduced.

study.proposed_difference: No added weights. Compute the inherited [B,L,T] positional logits in every cell. For shared routing, select the is_click column using the label-order-aware primary buffer and broadcast it to all tasks. For primary ownership, replace only auxiliary positional logits by their detached values. Task/joint is the incumbent replay; shared/joint and shared/primary are candidates; task/primary is an indirect-coupling and auxiliary-position-removal control. All cells start with exactly zero position corrections and the same inherited RNG stream. Same allocated56,351,704 parameters expected, not equal functional capacity:320 registered positional entries versus80 entries used by shared cells. No frozen optimizer, gradient clip, visibility, label, split or scoring contract changes.
predictions: Primary hypothesis: shared_primary exceeds shared_joint click AUC by at least0.0001; the corresponding task/private ownership contrast is smaller, giving D below -0.0001. This directional hypothesis is deliberately falsifiable; joint may instead help.

Shared_primary should retain click AUC within0.0001 of task_joint if most coupling was through the positional matrix; a larger difference motivates indirect-context/clipping follow-up rather than assuming direct auxiliary transfer.

At fixed weights shared_joint and shared_primary have identical predictions. Aux-only loss must give nonzero click position-row gradient in shared_joint on a nondegenerate synthetic host batch and exactly zero positional gradients in shared_primary. Other auxiliary pathways must still receive gradients.

Task_joint must match the original incumbent model at fixed inherited state for arbitrary task ordering. All cells have equal initial predictions, neutral gain for padding, and zero direct positional correction for empty histories. Training can still change empty-history predictions through shared parameters.

Report full-population click AUC/Logloss, all auxiliary AUC/Logloss and auxiliary mean separately, fixed history slices with sample/positive/negative counts, allocated/trainable/used position entries, wall/GPU seconds, examples, peak memory and throughput/p50/p95 batch latency. Any missing gradient/seed/bootstrap diagnostics remain missing rather than inferred.
falsifiers: Shared_joint matching or beating shared_primary falsifies the predicted negative effect of auxiliary supervision in this implementation; improvement favors complementary supervision and warrants paired repetition.

A similarly sized task/private ownership effect, or mixed task/slice outcomes without a reproducible factorial interaction, defeats a claim that direct shared positional ownership alone explains changes.
Task-private routes beating both shared variants leaves no evidence that positional forward sharing is useful under this recipe. It does not refute all cross-task mechanisms.

Failure of forward equality at fixed weights, gradient isolation, arbitrary label order, masking/current-action invariance or finite backward is an implementation failure, not scientific counterevidence. Correct it prospectively and retain charged failures.
An apparent one-seed gain disappearing under authorized paired seeds or user-cluster bootstrap leaves the mechanism unsupported; pooled impression independence is not assumed.
alternative_explanations: One frozen seed is preliminary; no inferential significance or originality claim.

Shared and task-private routes have different functional capacity even though both allocate320 positional entries. Shared cells use the80 entries of the click row; task/private/joint uses all320. Collapsed feedback also induces parameter redundancy.
Shared context, shared selector forward geometry, Dice statistics and global dense-gradient clipping remain indirect coupling paths. Gradient blocking applies only to the positional correction.
In task/primary, auxiliary positional matrices remain zero from scratch. This is an auxiliary-position-removal control, not an equally expressive trained auxiliary route.
Joint auxiliary gradients can change gradient magnitude and clipping as well as direction. A deficit alone does not prove opposing gradient directions; a later registered diagnostic would be needed.
Shared positional routing changes regularization/functional capacity; click gains over a private model do not by themselves establish complementary supervision.
All four BCEs remain unweighted: differing prevalence and scale may dominate joint updates. Directional gradient conflict is not measured by these AUC contrasts.
Offline history feedback maturity, whole-window vocabularies, category/brand label matching and one-pass seed-specific adaptation limit production conclusions. Rank is event count, not elapsed time.
The repeated collapsed feedback slots are algebraically redundant. Equal allocated parameters are not a claim of equal identifiable capacity or measured equal-compute performance.
